C0865.title: Multiple Enterprises' Financial Ledgers Encrypted by Locked Ransomware
C0865.summary: Qihoo 360’s June 2023 ransomware trend analysis shows that ransomware continued to affect enterprise environments that month, with attackers encrypting business files, databases, or server data to extort victim organizations. The material serves as a reference for the business-interruption risk that arises when financial ledgers, database files, or other critical enterprise data are encrypted by ransomware.

references.title: June 2023 Ransomware Threat Landscape Analysis (360 Digital Security Group)
